description_en: Queries the statistics information of the application whitelist policy
description_zh: 查询应用白名单策略统计信息
name: DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically retrieves the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the policies.
You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the maximum number of entries to return on each page during paging. In a paged query, the maximum value is 1000. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default.

Specify a value for the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。最大值为1000，每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。

建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page during paging in a paged query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page during paging in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on each page during paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is generated by Alibaba Cloud and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Strategies.description_en: The list of policy statistics information

AssetCount.description_en: The number of servers to which the policy is applied

Progress.description_en: The learning progress of the policy. Unit: percentage
Progress.description_zh: 策略学习进度。单位：百分比

Status.description_en:
The status of the policy. Valid values:
0: Disabled
1: Learning
2: Paused
3: Learning completed
4: Effective
Status.description_zh:
策略状态。取值：
0：未启用
1：学习中
2：暂停
3：学习完成
4：已生效

StudyTime.description_en: The duration of intelligent learning. Unit: hours
StudyTime.description_zh: 智能学习时长。单位：小时

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned during paging in a paged query
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时，数据总条数
